provenance.source_collection: Web reference collection README: 25 numbered groups, three resources per group.
provenance.url_handling: Resource hrefs were decoded from Facebook redirects by the source collection; only fbclid was removed. This catalog preserves those 75 URLs exactly.
provenance.editorial_note: English labels, descriptions, and routing tags are new summaries. Original Vietnamese group names and order are retained. No Facebook post text, comments, or images are bundled.
provenance.verification: Links and category membership reconciled against the captured collection. Service availability, pricing, license terms, and integration compatibility were not verified.
